summary: This directory centralizes user management functionality by providing service-level operations to retrieve, identify, and verify user account information and organizational membership relations.
relationships: The User Service acts as the primary interface for fetching and validating user-specific data.
Membership verification relies on the service's ability to cross-reference user identities with existing system relations.
designDecisions: Service-oriented interface for domain entity management
Encapsulation of retrieval logic behind a unified service class
